questions: Does discovery identify coherent ownership and relevant dependencies?
Can implementer discovery contexts remain useful for later authorized implementation?
Are proposed models and effort justified by the remaining assignment?
Can organization revisions preserve approvals and live collection ownership?
Is the candidate reviewable without discovery transcripts?
observations_to_preserve: proposed versus realized roles and ownership
reasons for revised scope or selection
review findings and repair rounds if later implementation is authorized
recoverable role usage with comparable definitions and explicit gaps
limits: No controlled model-cost experiment; no implementation-continuity or revision-success claim can be established by formation alone.
